info.title: EDUS Local Service API
info.description: Backend-owned same-origin contract. Loopback only. No administrative HTTP endpoints. Request size256KiB. No wildcard CORS. Error codes are extensible; unknown codes display a safe localized fallback. Dates ISO8601; nullable explicit.
